thesis: Ash Fontana argues that while vertical market software and SaaS models currently offer an opportunity of a lifetime due to their high-quality, recurring revenue streams, the basis of competitive advantage is shifting because building such software is no longer difficult. He contends that future competitive advantage will depend on the ability to make decisions for users using data and machine learning, which is significantly harder than simply assembling existing API blocks or infrastructure services.
